texts: good. the wraith, the draining and the West Row's lanterns are all recorded, the lanterns as one definite group in the affected slot — so the draining is stated of the group, and a single lantern named later is not itself queryable as drained.

bad: "what happens to X?" names no verb, so the translator has to guess which slot would hold the harvest (it emitted two guesses, one Patient line and one Theme line), and the question also makes "at the West Row" a separate containment fact about the harvest that has to be proved. The premise ties the West Row only to its lanterns and never mentions a thread harvest, so nothing can match. Name the consequence you are asking about and tie the harvest to the row the way the premise ties the lanterns: "Does the wraith's draining ruin the West Row's thread harvest?" — with whichever consequence verb you actually mean in place of "ruin".
